text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it is full of nutritioooon, 
DEEEEEESU! I'll treat you to some as well, 
Spe-chan!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, El-chan! I've never had a 
cactus before~!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer! Would you like some cactus 
too, Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Mom and Dad sent it to me to help cheer me 
uuup!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I had no idea cactus was edible! El-chan 
told me, and I was so surprised!
choice_data_list: How are you gonna cook it?
How are you going to cook it?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Turn it into steak, put it in hamburgers, 
make it into a smoothie, all sorts of 
things, YES!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Whoaa! There are that many recipes?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
El's Papa taught me! It's one of my 
specialty dishes, deeeeesu!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"I'll treat you to a meal too, Trainer! Do 
you have any requests!?"
choice_data_list: I think I'll have a smoothie!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Steak was a staple in our home!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
It's really filling, and it's great for 
diets too, yes!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Fullness...! A diet!! Amazing, it's like 
magic food!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu! You really took the bait, 
Spe-chan!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Build the ultimate physique with cactus 
steak, all while having fun dieting!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I'll borrow the dorm kitchen! Let's go 
start making it right away!!

El Condor Pasa cooked for me, and I 
enjoyed the cactus steak... or so it 
seemed, but.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I-I ate way too much. I can't move 
anymore...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Phew~... I'm so full... but so happy...!

It was a day that taught me no matter how 
good it is for a diet, overeating 
completely defeats the purpose.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Sounds great! They say cacti have a 
soothing effect on the mind, too!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Is that so! Then could it be――

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe I can become a calm and composed 
Umamusume just like Suzuka-san!?"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Perhaps you're right!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The reason El can always stay cool and 
composed might just be thanks to the 
cactus!

Deciding not to comment on his lack of 
composure, I promptly accepted the offer 
of a cactus smoothie.

El Condor Pasa made me a cactus smoothie, 
and just as I was about to enjoy it in the 
cafeteria—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ouuuch!? A t-thorn was still in there! 
Ugh, it pricked the inside of my cheek...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
El-chan, are you okay?! Oh, so what 
happened earlier was a thorn?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
!? Spe-chan, you ate all of that!? Are you 
a camel!?

While being very careful of the thorns... 
I enjoyed the cactus smoothie.
